notes.title: New Feature: Marijuana Vending Machines 🌿🌿🌿🌿
notes.notes:
[b]New Feature[/b]
🌿Marijuana Vending Machines have been added to the game to buy and enjoy.


[b] Bug Fixes:[/b]
🔧Lobby UI Fix: Lobby UI elements no longer appear during the intro sequence.
🔧Synchronized Death Cinematic: Both players now no longer see the same death cinematic in multiplayer.
🔧Chest Looting Fix: Chests now properly disappear after being looted instead of remaining in the air.
🔧Bottom G Achievement: Now correctly triggers when conditions are met.
🔧Grenade Launcher Achievement Fix: No longer incorrectly unlocks the Heavy Pistol achievement.
🔧Safe Timer Adjustment: The safe now ignores break time, and money becomes collectible sooner.

[b] Balance & Mechanics Adjustments:[/b]
🎯Magic Projectile Buff: Increased the chance of magic projectiles triggering.
🎯Compact Pistol Removal: Removed from the game along with its associated achievement.


[b] UI & QoL Improvements:[/b]
🖥️Optimized Performance
🖥️Client Return Button: Added a return button for clients joining a lobby.
🖥️Progress Menu Fixes: correct Icons
🖥️Weapon Slots Widget: Added a UI widget to display the four available weapon slots—Grenade, Main Weapon, Handgun, and Knife.

[b] Audio Adjustments:[/b]
🔊FBI Agents Voice Volume Increased: Adjusted to ensure clear audibility.

Thank you for Playing!
